name: BIOHITECH GLOBAL DL-,0001
summary: BioHiTech Global, Inc. specializes in delivering waste management services. Based in Chestnut Ridge, New York, the company operates through its subsidiaries, BioHiTech America, LLC and BioHiTech Europe Limited, providing clients with technologies that integrate technological, biological, and mechanical engineering principles to effectively manage, decrease, or repurpose organic waste. The company holds a comprehensive distribution license for its flagship Eco-Safe Digester product, a data-driven, network-connected mechanical-biological system designed to convert food waste into nutrient-neutral water that can be safely discharged into conventional sanitary sewer systems. This is particularly beneficial for businesses in sectors such as food service, hospitality, healthcare, government, conference facilities, educational establishments, and sports stadiums. Complementing this, the company's BioHiTech Cloud is an internet-enabled platform that streams real-time operational data from the digesters.
